sql:
select
  direction,
  count(*) as transaction_count,
  count(order_id) as transactions_with_order_id,
  round(100.0 * count(order_id) / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) as pct_with_order_id,
  count(distinct order_id) as distinct_order_ids_referenced
from loyalty_transactions
where occurred_at >= date '2023-01-01'
  and occurred_at < date '2026-01-01'
group by direction
order by transaction_count desc, direction
note: Grain is one row per direction value as requested, covering all tenants and the full 2023-01-01 to 2025-12-31 window (upper bound applied as occurred_at < 2026-01-01).
